name: Ashlight
summary: A smart-home board in grey frosted glass: drag, resize, hide and add widgets over a soft room
about: A complete smart-home dashboard for one house in quiet greys, with frosted glass panels over a soft, blurred picture of a study. The home screen is a board of widgets (clock, climate, energy, a living-room window, lights, scenes, locks, a live camera, family and music) that you can rearrange, resize, hide and add to, and it remembers your layout. Rooms, devices, climate, energy and a searchable activity log fill the other pages. Good for a smart-home or home-automation product, in pale grey or charcoal.
how: Press Edit board: widgets jiggle; drag one onto another to reorder, or use the arrow buttons from the keyboard
Tap S, M or L to resize a widget and the cross to hide it (Undo brings it back)
Press Add widget to bring back hidden widgets such as Notes, Air quality and Rooms
Use the widgets directly: lights switch, the living-room lamp glows in its window, scenes run and the camera opens
Turn the cooling dial in Climate, switch 24H, 30D or 12M in Energy and search or export the activity log
Change the glass blur, reset the board or reset the demo in Settings
